description: TikTok’s ad-cleared music for the ad account — the sound a CAROUSEL ad needs (musicId on create_tiktok_ads_ad with adFormat CAROUSEL_ADS). Search by keyword, get recommendations for 2-35 already-uploaded carousel images (imageUrls), look up musicIds, or read the liked / history / your-uploads lists (searchType); scene CREATIVE_ASSET lists the creative-tools library instead. Preview URLs last 12 hours. Read-only, free.

advertiserId.description: TikTok ad account id from list_tiktok_ads_accounts; omit when only one account is shared with this profile

imageUrls.description: 2-35 URLs of images already uploaded to the ad account

keyword.description: search text for the music library

pageSize.description: rows to fetch from TikTok; the reply shows the first 30

scene.description: CAROUSEL_ADS when searching; CREATIVE_ASSET for the creative-tools library

searchType.description: SEARCH_BY_KEYWORD, SEARCH_BY_RECOMMEND, SEARCH_BY_LIKED, SEARCH_BY_HISTORY, SEARCH_BY_MUSIC_ID or SEARCH_BY_SOURCE

name: list_tiktok_ads_music
title: Find TikTok ad music
